title: Townsend Brown and Ning Li claims of weight reduction and gravitational shielding
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Townsend Brown and Ning Li claims of weight reduction and gravitational shielding, about 1950s-2000s at University of Alabama Huntsville, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: a bunch of people over the last 70 years the foremost in my mind Towns and Brown and you know this uh Ningly at University of Alabama Huntsville saying that they're getting little weight reduction effects gravitational shielding

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that over the last 70 years a number of people have claimed small effects on gravity. He names the inventor Townsend Brown and a scientist named Ning Li at the University of Alabama in Huntsville, who he says reported objects losing a little weight and a kind of shielding from gravity. If true, it would hint that gravity can be controlled.
